name: Low-pressure refrigerant R1233zd(E)
summary: HFO refrigerant used in two-phase cold plates (Accelsius lists R1233zd(E) and R-515B). Boils near 18 °C at atmospheric pressure, so it absorbs heat as latent heat at nearly constant temperature. Low GWP, but under the EU PFAS definition debate.

cpJPerKgK.note: Liquid cp 0.298 Btu/lb°F at 30 °C per Honeywell's Solstice zd data (page did not load during research; value from search excerpt). Sensible cp is secondary; two-phase heat transport uses latent heat (~190 kJ/kg).

densityKgM3.note: Liquid at the 18.3 °C normal boiling point (Honeywell data via search excerpt); ~1250 at 30 °C.

viscosityPaS.note: Liquid viscosity 470.1 µPa·s at 25 °C (Honeywell data via search excerpt).
